risks: Minimal: secondary use of clinical records; no contact with patients.
consent: Waiver of consent approved by the research ethics board (REB-2026-0931) for chart-based data.
data: Extract held on the hospital research server with study numbers; no names leave the ICU information system.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: patients admitted at weekends or with language barriers may be mobilised less; day of week and interpreter need are recorded and reported.
effectiveness: A clear association would support investment in weekend physiotherapy and sedation practice.
efficiency: Existing records and two research nurse days per week.
partnerships: ICU director, bedside nurse educators, two ICU survivors from the unit's follow-up clinic.
rebPath: Approved with a waiver of consent (REB-2026-0931) under TCPS 2.
limitations: Residual confounding; documentation quality; single unit.
